summary: Frontend E2E tested new 'Mira Lead Agent' super-admin tab. All specified UI flows pass: tab renders, panel + funnel cards match seeded DB (5/300, 5/100, 1/50→2/50 after approve, 1/10→2/10 after demo, 1/5), completed run log displays, lead rows expand with score breakdown chips + website link, BBlunt (customer) correctly hides editable email inputs, Approve→Resend send on Naturals succeeds and increments emails_sent to 2, Mark Demo booked flips to demo and increments demos to 2, reject on Toni&Guy flips to rejected. Regression: Tenants tab (176 rows) and Lead Gen Email (DemoCampaign) tabs render fine. No new pipeline run was triggered.

issues: After a lead is marked 'demo', the Reject button re-appears (condition !['sent','customer','rejected'].includes(status) allows reject on 'demo'/'drafted'/'no_email'/'researched'). A demo-booked lead probably shouldn't be rejectable — minor UX concern.

For status='demo' or 'rejected' the editable email/subject/body inputs are still shown (condition only hides on 'sent' and 'customer'); user could edit a rejected lead's draft with no effect on send. Minor.

action_items: Minor: consider hiding Reject button when status is 'demo' (can only be rejected before demo booked).
Minor: hide editable email/subject/body inputs when status is 'demo' or 'rejected' (currently only hidden on 'sent'/'customer') to avoid confusing no-op edits.
critical_code_review_comments: MiraLeadAgent.jsx: pollRef interval keeps polling every 6s while a run is running — fine, but on unmount only clearInterval is called; if the component remounts while a run is in-flight polling never resumes until user clicks run again. Minor.

LeadRow approve() diff-checks strict equality against undefined-vs-empty-string could send PUT redundantly when server returns null vs '' for empty fields; not blocking but could cause an extra PUT before /approve.
